question.problem:
What division problem is represented by the model below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/b1cea7679d63c16d43e1f9b2f156cbd69057a6668fca2a4ee8bd868716631857.png)
question.worked_solution:
We have $\dfrac{5}{7}$ on the left and $\dfrac{5}{21}$ on the right.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14133144/assets/84cba43457adc42afc433238410fefc9fe98b042d326c10ea3fce6221e7e620c.png)

Therefore, the division problem shown is

$$
\dfrac{5}{7} \div 3 = \dfrac{5}{21}.
$$
